intent: Author one migration table through the GPMC COM API (GPMgmt.GPM CreateMigrationTable/AddEntry/Save) and read the bytes back -- a setup-only transaction with no interactive step that exercises the full engine plumbing (ensure-console, recovery check, pre-oracle, prepare/arm, commit crossing, converge/reproduce, envelope, cleanup) at near-zero surface risk (work order R1).

structured_checks.checks: The root element tag is recorded verbatim; whether GPMC's namespace matches migration.py's hardcoded {http://www.microsoft.com/GroupPolicy/Types} is the R1 answer, registered from the record. The require clause carries the informal check; the exact comparison is analysis work on the record.
Each mapping's Source/Destination fields (Identifier/Sid/Name children, types) are recorded as dotted facts; the four authored rows make split vs flat shapes visible.

bindings.args: Bound at load time by wcd.exec_transaction.
bindings.fact_vocabulary: migtable.* facts come from the migration_table observer (controller-side XML parse of transported bytes).

recovery.demonstration: estate baseline checkpoint existence asserted at prepare
